name: ui.design
description: Frontend/UX/UI gate. Scores a screen description, component, or design spec.

primary_action_obvious.instructions: The single primary action on this screen is visually obvious within a second

states_handled.instructions: Loading, empty, error, and success states are all accounted for

accessible.instructions: Contrast, focus order, labels, and keyboard reachability are addressed

mobile_considered.instructions: Behaviour at small viewport widths is specified rather than assumed

jargon.instructions: The copy uses internal jargon the intended user would not recognise

clarity.instructions: How clearly does this communicate what to do next
criteria: Immediately obvious, nothing competes with the primary action
